pull.title: doc: fix comments referring to nonexistent functions
pull.body:
Fix documentation that refers to functions that don't exist, or were renamed.

Maybe there's a lint or Ralph type check we can add for these.

ACK 43ba29a7dbec42a423e572e1acd5c4bfbe13db57

One further documentation nit. Otherwise, the updated references match the code.

> Maybe there's a lint or Ralph type check we can add for these. cc willcl-ark.

This is attempted (at least partially) in https://github.com/willcl-ark/nix/commit/d0aeeb22d46c2002170481ef908fc6fcdbcaed75

It checks symbol references in changed comments/docs, and looks for stale references left by function removals or renames, including in unchanged files. Obvsiouly itsan LLM review check rather than a deterministic lint, so we'll need to see how reliably it catches these in practice...

comments.body:
In 43ba29a7dbec42a423e572e1acd5c4bfbe13db57

Could also drop the references to "wkey" and CWalletKey here I think. LoadKey() only handles "key" records now; LoadLegacyWalletRecords() explicitly rejects "wkey" records with DBErrors::LOAD_FAIL.
